A “Setu” coin with a bull on the obverse: Ndalama ya "Setu" yokhala ndi ng'ombe panjira. Mawu akuti Setu - mlatho wopita ku Lanka, ku Rameswaram - amawonekera pa ndalama za olamulira a Tamil a mu ufumu wa Jaffna mochedwa; ng'ombe yamphongo, Shiva's Nandi, ndi chipangizo chawo wamba.
A burial urn of the kind that made Adich: Urn manda amtundu womwe unapangitsa Adichanallur kutchuka. Akufa - kapena mafupa awo osonkhanitsidwa - adayikidwa mu urn wotero ndi katundu wa manda ndikukwiriridwa pansi pa miyala pamwamba pa Thamirabarani. Urns ndi ulalo wachindunji ku முதுமக்கள் தாழி wa ndakatulo za Sangam.
A catalogue of the coins issued by the C: Ndandanda ya ndalama zoperekedwa ndi mafumu a Chera, Chola, ndi Pandya, limodzi ndi zizindikiro zawo zaufumu za uta, nyalugwe, ndi nsomba.
A ceramic vessel from Adichanallur. Smal: Chombo cha ceramic chochokera ku Adichanallur. Miphika yaing'ono ngati iyi inkaikidwa mkati kapena pambali pa manda, mwinamwake kukhala ndi chakudya, madzi kapena zopereka za akufa - chithunzithunzi cha chikhulupiriro cha Iron Age paulendo wopitirira imfa.
A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Galeta la galeta la wokwawa, shawl kwa nkhanga, chipatso chopatsa moyo kwa wolemba ndakatulo: mphatso zodziwika kwambiri za ogula zimawoneka zosatheka, ndipo ndiyo mfundo yawo. Kodai madam ndi wowolowa manja kwambiri kotero kuti woperekayo samawerengera ntchito ya mphatsoyo - chifundo choperekedwa kwa nyama, zomera ndi kuphunzira mofanana.
A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Ndalama ya Chera yomwe ili ku Napier Museum, Thiruvananthapuram. Ndalama zachitsulo za Chera zimakhala ndi uta ndi muvi, chizindikiro cha mzera wa mafumu, ndipo zitsanzo zambiri zoyambirira zimachokera ku Karur, likulu la Chera pa Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Kalonga wa mzere wa Ay kumwera kwa mapiri a Podiyil (Pothigai). Mwambo wodziŵika bwino umanena za kupereka kwake chovala chamtengo wapatali kwa mulungu, wodziŵika mofala kukhala Shiva—kupereka monga kudzipereka limodzi ndi kuwolowa manja.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Mtsogoleri wa mzere wa Malaiyaman, wa dziko lozungulira Mullur ndi Tirukkoyilur, adakumbukiridwa chifukwa cha chifundo chake kwa olemba ndakatulo ndi onse omwe adabwera kwa iye. Malo ake pakati pa alonda asanu ndi awiri akusonyeza kuti ulemu wa wolamulira unkayezedwa ndi kupereka kwake mofanana ndi dera lake.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Ndalama ya Chola yonyamula chizindikiro chachifumu cha Pandya. Pamene a Cholas adabweretsa dziko la Pandya pansi pa ulamuliro wawo, adayika nsomba ya Pandya pambali pa nyalugwe wawo - chizindikiro cha kugonjetsa chomwe chinapangidwa kukhala chitsulo.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Mzinda umene mabuku, chithandizo cha mfumu, chipembedzo ndi moyo wa m’tauni zakhala zikuchitikira kwa zaka pafupifupi 2,000.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing title “Malai Nadu konda Chola” — a Chola omwe adatenga dziko lamapiri, ndiko kuti, dziko la Chera. Mafumu a Chola adalengeza za kupambana kwawo m'maudindo ogundidwa pa ndalama zawo komanso zojambulidwa m'zolemba zawo.
A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Ndalama ya Kulottunga I (1070-1120 CE), yomwe inagwirizanitsa mizere ya Chola ndi Chalukya ya Kum'mawa ndikulamulira chimodzi mwa maulamuliro a Chola aatali kwambiri komanso otukuka kwambiri. Ndalama zake zimapitilira mitundu ya Chola yomwe idakhazikitsidwa ndi dzina lake mu Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Ndalama ya Rajaraja I. Ndalama zake zamkuwa zamkuwa za mtundu woyimilira komanso wokhala pansi, womwe unayambitsidwa pambuyo pa kugonjetsa kwake kumpoto kwa Sri Lanka, unafalikira kwambiri kumbali zonse za nyanja ndipo unatsanziridwa kwa zaka mazana ambiri.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Ndalama ya ufumu wa Jaffna yosonyeza hatchi yokhala ndi nsomba. Mafumu achi Tamil a ku Jaffna (zaka za 13th-17th) adapereka ndalama mumwambo waku South Indian, chikumbutso cha ubale wapamtima kudutsa Palk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Ndalama ya Kongu Cheras, mzere wa Chera womwe unkalamulira dziko la Kongu kumadzulo kwa Chitamil (kuzungulira masiku ano a Coimbatore, Erode ndi Karur) - dera lomwelo lomwe lapereka ndalama zambiri zachitsulo zachiroma.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Wovekedwa korona, wokhala ndi masharubu pambiri, atavala jekete ya miyala ya miyala yamtengo wapatali komanso masikhafu oyenda, amakweza ndodo ya nthenga. Nkhope ndi manja zimakokedwa mu mzere wakuda wakuda pamtunda wotumbululuka ndi mikanjo yotsuka mu ocher, pinki ndi yobiriwira - phunziro lofanana ndi chithunzi cha kavalidwe ka khoti mu zojambula zapakachisi.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Tsatanetsatane wa denga lopaka utoto la phanga la Jain ku Sittanavasal: ma lotus apinki otseguka pakati pa zobiriwira zobiriwira, nyama ikuyenda m'madzi ndi chithunzi chikutola maluwa. Dziwe nthawi zambiri limawerengedwa ngati lotus moat ya samavasarana, msonkhano wakumwamba komwe Jain Tirthankara amalalikira, ndi maluwa osonkhanitsa okhulupirika kuti apereke.
A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Chombo chamaliro chochokera ku maliro a mapiri a Nilgiri, chivundikiro chake chokhala ndi zithunzi zojambulidwa. Ofukula a m'zaka za m'ma 1900 a Nilgiri cairns anapeza zophimba zambiri zoterezi zokhala ndi anthu, nyama ndi okwera - zithunzi zazing'ono mu dongo zomwe zingasonyeze moyo ndi udindo wa akufa.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Chidutswa chamaluwa cha ma vesi zana limodzi ndi makumi asanu a akam olembedwa ndi Kanimethaviyar, ena makumi atatu pa malo aliwonse asanu.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Ndalama yagolide ya Rajaraja I (985-1014 CE), womanga kachisi wamkulu ku Thanjavur. Ikuwonetsa chizindikiro chachifumu cha Chola: nyalugwe wokhala pansi atazunguliridwa ndi nsomba ziwiri za Pandya, pansi pa mpando wachifumu, wokhala ndi dzina la mfumu ku Nagari - a Chola akuti akulamulira kumwera.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Golide theka-kahavanu wa Virarajendra Chola (1063-1070 CE). Kahavanu (wochokera ku kakapana) anali chipembedzo chagolide cha Sri Lanka, ndipo golide wa Chola anakanthidwa ndi muyezo uwu akuwonetsa nthawi ya ulamuliro wa Chola pachilumbachi.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Ndakatulo yotsogolera ya Ten Idylls yolembedwa ndi Kadiyalur Uruthirankananar. Bard yokhala ndi yazh yayikulu imatsogozedwa kwa Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan waku Kanchi; m’njira ndakatuloyo ikupereka zithunzi zooneka bwino za midzi, madoko, ndi anthu.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Ndakatulo yotsogolera ya Ten Idylls yolembedwa ndi Mudathama Kanniyar. Katswiri woimba ng'oma (porunar) yemwe wadalitsidwa kwambiri amalondolera gulu lina kwa mfumu yowolowa manja ya Chola Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Ndakatulo yotsogolera ya Ten Idyll yolemba Nallur Nathathanar. Bard yemwe amaimba yazh yaying'ono (zeze) amatsogolera wina kwa mfumu Nalliyakkodan, kufotokoza zovuta za bard osauka ndi kutentha kwa wowolowa manja wothandizira.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Ndakatulo yotsogolera ya Ten Idyll yolembedwa ndi Perunkausikanar. Osewera oyendayenda (koothar) amatsogoleredwa kwa mfumu Nannan; ndakatuloyi imakondweretsedwa chifukwa chogwira mawu ambiri a mapiri.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Mtsuko waukulu wosungirako wogwirizana ndi Adichanallur. Mitsuko yayikulu inali ndi tirigu, madzi ndi zakudya zina; m'maliro, zotengera zazikuluzikuluzi zimatha kukhala ngati urns. Mawu akuti "dolio" amakumbukira dolium, mbiya yayikulu yosungiramo zinthu za dziko la Roma.
A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Urn wamkulu, wozungulira wa funerary urn wochokera ku Adichanallur. Urn ngati uwu ukhoza kuyima wamtali kuposa wa mwana, ndipo kuwapanga kunafuna luso lalikulu: Olemba ndakatulo a Sangam amalankhula ndi woumba mbiya amene anapanga mizati monga கலம்செய் கோவே — “Inu mfumu pakati pa oumba”.
A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Ndalama yotsogola yochokera ku Andipatti yokhala ndi nthano yaku Tamil-Brahmi. Kupatulapo mafumu atatu ovekedwa korona, akalonga am’deralo a m’nthawi ya Sangam anapereka ndalama zachitsulo zokhala ndi mtovu ndi zamkuwa, ndipo nthano za Chitamil-Brahmi pa iwo zimathandiza kulemba mayina kwa olamulira ameneŵa.
A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Chithunzi chojambula cha vimana ndi holo yopimidwa ya Brihadisvara Temple.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Ndakatulo yachikondi ya Ma Idyll Khumi yolembedwa ndi Kapilar, yomwe ili kumapiri (kurinji). Mwambo umanena kuti zinalembedwa kuti ziphunzitse mfumu ya kumpoto kukongola kwa ndakatulo za chikondi cha Tamil; imatchula maluwa makumi asanu ndi anayi mphambu asanu ndi anayi.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Kulingalira kwamakono kwa doko lotanganidwa la zombo, misika ndi nsanja, pambuyo pa kufotokozera ku Silappathikaram ndi Pattinappalai. Siumboni wa mmene mzindawo unaonekera.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Chojambula chamakono chojambula zombo ndi nyumba padoko lakale. Monga kumangidwanso kulikonse kwa Puhar, kumatanthauzira mafotokozedwe olembedwa; dongosolo lonse la doko silikudziwika.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Dzina lolumikizidwa ndi Nedunalvadai ndi Tirumurukarruppatai mu Idyll Khumi - ngakhale lingakhale la ndakatulo zingapo nthawi zosiyanasiyana. Nthano ina imanena za kukana kwake kugamula ndakatulo ngakhale kwa Shiva ku bwalo la Pandya: chizindikiro cha kulimba mtima kwanzeru, osati zochitika zakale.
A palm-leaf manuscript from the museum’s: Zolemba pamanja za tsamba la kanjedza zochokera kumalo osungiramo zinthu zakale.
A Pandya coin of the “massa” type. Massa: Ndalama ya Pandya yamtundu wa "massa". Massa ndi dzina loperekedwa kwa ndalama zamkuwa zam'zaka zapakati zomwe zikuwonetsa chithunzi choyimirira mbali imodzi ndi chithunzi chokhala pansi pa chimzake - mtundu womwe umafalikira ndi a Cholas ndipo unapitirizidwa ndi Pandyas ndi mafumu a Sri Lanka.
A Pandya coin showing a standing king wi: Ndalama ya Pandya yosonyeza mfumu yaimirira yokhala ndi chizindikiro cha nsomba. Chithunzi cha wolamulira woyimilira, wodziwika bwino ndi ndalama zamkuwa za Chola, adatengedwa ndi a Pandyas pamene mphamvu zawo zinatsitsimutsidwa m'zaka za zana la 13.
A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Ndalama ya Pandya yokhala ndi nsomba ziwiri ndi ng'ombe. Nsomba zophatikiziridwazo zinakhala chizindikiro chosatha cha Pandya, chojambulidwa pa zikwangwani za ndakatulo za Madurai ndi kugundidwa ndi ndalama zachitsulo kwa zaka zoposa chikwi.
A pipeline of terracotta rings, set one: Mpope wa mphete za terracotta, zoyikidwa pamwamba pazigawo zinayi, zowonekera pakufukula kwa Korkai. Mapaipi adongo oyaka ndi zitsime za mphete monga chonchi ankanyamula ndi kukhetsa madzi m'matauni a mbiri yakale ya dziko la Tamil - gawo la uinjiniya wa tsiku ndi tsiku wa doko lotanganidwa.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Ndakatulo ya Ma Idyll Khumi yolembedwa ndi Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar, yotamanda mfumu ya Chola Karikal Valavan ndi mzinda wake womwe uli ndi doko la Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar), ndi zombo zake, misika, ndi zikondwerero.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Ndakatulo ya Ma Idyll Khumi yolembedwa ndi Nakkeerar. M’nyengo ya mphepo yaitali, yozizira yakumpoto ya nyengo yachisanu, mfumukazi imalakalaka mwamuna wake pamene mfumu ikusamalira asilikali ake ovulala m’misasa yankhondo.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Ndalama ya chithunzi cha mfumu ya Chera Kuttuvan Kotai, yomwe imamutcha mu Tamil-Brahmi. Ndi ndalama za siliva za Makkotai, nkhani za siliva zosowa izi - mwina zouziridwa ndi ndalama zachiroma zachiroma zomwe zimafika kudzera mu malonda - zili m'gulu la ndalama zoyambirira za ku India zowonetsa nkhope ya wolamulira.
A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Phale lolembedwa ku Tamil-Brahmi, lomwe linapezeka ku Tissamaharama kum'mwera kwa Sri Lanka ndipo linalembedwa cha m'ma 200 BCE. Kulemba mu Chitamil pamiphika yomwe ili kutali ndi dziko la Tamil kumawonetsa amalonda aku Tamil akugwira ntchito kutsidya la nyanja m'mbiri yakale.
A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Buku losowa kwambiri lazaka makumi angapo zoyambirira za kusindikiza kwa Chitamil, pomwe zolemba zakale zosungidwa pamasamba a kanjedza zinali kusindikizidwa koyamba.
A rare volume digitised from CICT’s arch: Voliyumu yosowa yosungidwa pakompyuta ya CICT ndikusungidwa kuti iphunzire. Tsatanetsatane wa ndandanda yonse idzawonjezedwa ndi oyang'anira museum.
A Sangam-age Chola coin with a tiger and: Ndalama ya Chola ya Sangam ndi nyalugwe ndi njovu. Ndalama zoyambirira za Chola, makamaka zamkuwa, zomwe zili pakati pa kambuku - chizindikiro chomwecho chimene mfumu Cholas idzanyamula zaka chikwi pambuyo pake. Uraiyur ndi Kaveripoompattinam anali malo awo akuluakulu.
A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Ndalama ya Pandya ya zaka za Sangam, yomwe nthawi zambiri imakhala ndi bwalo laling'ono lamkuwa wokhala ndi njovu mbali imodzi ndi nsomba yojambulidwa mbali inayo. Ndalama zoterezi zinkazungulira ndi kuzungulira Madurai, likulu la Pandya lokondwerera ku Maduraikkanchi.
A scholarly study of government, adminis: Kafukufuku wamaphunziro a boma, oyang'anira, komanso moyo wa anthu m'dziko la Tamil la m'badwo wa Sangam.
A second coin of the Kongu Cheras. Compa: Ndalama yachiwiri ya Kongu Cheras. Yerekezerani ziwirizi: ndalama zogwidwa pamanja zimasiyana malinga ndi kumenyedwa, kuvala ndi kudula, ndipo kusiyana koteroko kumathandiza okhulupirira manambala kuti azitha kuwongolera ndikuwona kuchuluka kwa ndalama zomwe zidakhalapo.
A second image of the four-armed, seated: Chithunzi chachiwiri cha zida zinayi, atakhala Ganesha. Yerekezerani kuchuluka kwake, zokongoletsera ndi kutembenuka kwa thunthu ndi koyamba: mkati mwa canon yogawana ya Silpa Sastras, wosema aliyense ndi msonkhano adasiya kukhudza kwake.
A selection drawn from the Thirukkural,: Kusankhidwa kochokera ku Thirukkural, kusonkhanitsa ma couplets osayiwalika kwa owerenga.
A separate photographing of the opening: Kujambula kosiyana kwa masamba otsegulira a mtolo 579 D, Maduraikkanchi.
Wopatulika wa Shaiva, manja amalumikizana pakupembedza. Mafumu a Chola analemekeza a Nayanmar makumi asanu ndi limodzi mphambu atatu, omwe Sekkizhar adanena mu Periya Puranam, ndipo mafano awo amkuwa anaikidwa m'kachisi ndikunyamulidwa m'maphwando.
A sherd illustrated in Vimala Begley’s 1: Sherd yomwe ikuwonetsedwa mu kafukufuku wa Vimala Begley wa 1983 wokhudzana ndi chibwenzi cha Arikamedu. Kuwunikanso zigawo zofukulidwazo, Begley adanena kuti kukhazikikako kudayamba cha m'ma 300 BCE - kale Mortimer Wheeler adanenanso - ndi anthu aku Mediterranean kumapeto kwa zaka za zana lachiwiri BCE. Madeti ake amakhalabe kutanthauzira kwaukatswiri.
A sherd of an urn found in 2004, decorat: Chigawo cha urn chomwe chinapezeka mu 2004, chokongoletsedwa ndi mpumulo wogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi chithunzi chachikazi choyimirira pakati pa zojambula zomwe zimawerengedwa ngati mapesi a paddy, nswala, crane ndi ng'ona. Akatswiri awona mwa iye mulungu wamkazi wakale - ena, monga momwe filimuyo imanenera, wotsogolera Kotravai, mulungu wankhondo wa ndakatulo za Sangam. Ndi chimodzi mwazithunzi zosowa za Iron Age Tamil Nadu.
A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Kalozera wachidule wowonetsa alendo: zomwe ndakatulo za Sangam zili, momwe zimasanjidwira, komanso momwe ndakatulo za akam ndi puram ndi malo asanu amagwirira ntchito.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: Kasu wasiliva wa Rajendra Chola wophatikiza zizindikiro zachifumu - nyalugwe wa Chola ndi nsomba ya Pandya ndi uta wa Chera. Rajendra Woyamba (1014-1044 CE) adanyamula mphamvu za Chola kupita ku Ganges ndi kuwoloka nyanja mpaka kumwera chakum'mawa kwa Asia, ndipo ndalama zake zimalengeza kulamulira kwake kwa nduwira zonse zitatu za Tamil.
A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attr: Kasu ya siliva ya mtundu wa "Uttama", womwe umatchulidwa pano ndi Rajendra I. Mtunduwu umatenga dzina lake kuchokera ku ndalama za Uttama Chola, zomwe mapangidwe ake - kambuku, nsomba ndi uta pansi pa parasol - adayika chitsanzo cha pambuyo pake Chola siliva.
A simplified sequence of how cloth is ma: Ndondomeko yophweka ya momwe nsalu imapangidwira. Ikufotokoza ndondomeko yonse; si umboni kuti msonkhano uliwonse wakale wa Chitamil udatsata ndendende njira izi - zida, ndi dongosolo la utoto ndi kuluka, lingasiyane.
A small pottery cup from the Adichanallu: Kapu yaying'ono youmba mbiya kuchokera kumanda a Adichanallur. Makapu, mbale ndi zivindikiro zinali pakati pa katundu wofala kwambiri wa kumanda, ndipo kusamala kwake, ngakhale mawonekedwe ake amasonyeza luso la oumba pogwira ntchito pagudumu pafupifupi zaka zikwi zitatu zapitazo.
A summit of Chola architecture, art and: Msonkhano waukulu wa zomangamanga za Chola, luso ndi kayendetsedwe ka ntchito; gawo la UNESCO Great Living Chola Temples.
A temple gopuram over a Madurai street: Gopuram wa kachisi pamwamba pa msewu wa Madurai
A vast open-air relief carved across two: Chifaniziro chachikulu chapanja chojambulidwa pamiyala iwiri, chotchedwa Arjuna's Penance kapena Descent of the Ganga, chikuwonetsa milungu, anzeru, nyama, ndi banja la njovu lokhala ndi moyo likutembenukira pamphamba wachilengedwe.
A village on the Noyyal in Erode distric: Mudzi womwe uli pa Noyyal m'boma la Erode, womwe unafukulidwa ngati malo opangira mikanda, miyala yamtengo wapatali komanso chitsulo ndi zitsulo.
A Visitor’s Guide to Sangam Literature: Kalozera wa Alendo ku Zolemba za Sangam
A volume connected with the Madurai Tami: Voliyumu yolumikizidwa ndi Madurai Tamil Sangam, Literary Academy yomwe idakhazikitsidwa ku Madurai mu 1901 ndi Pandithurai Thevar ndipo nthawi zambiri amatchedwa "Fourth Tamil Sangam".
A volume from the shrine’s collection of: Voliyumu yochokera m'malo omasulira a Thirukkural. Uthenga wa ubwino wa Kural wafika kwa oŵerenga m’zinenero zambiri za ku India ndi zapadziko lonse.
A volume on the poetry of Kambar, the gr: Voliyumu ya ndakatulo ya Kambar, wolemba ndakatulo wamkulu wa Kamba Ramayanam (Ramavataram), yemwe luso lake lachi Tamil linamupatsa dzina lakuti "Kavichakravarthi", mfumu ya ndakatulo.
A vyala or yali, the horned, lion-like g: A vyala kapena yali, nyanga, chilombo ngati mkango ku South Indian akachisi. A Pallavas adapanga siginecha yawo, akuyika mizati pakulera mikango ndi yalis ku Mamallapuram ndi Kanchipuram; omanga pambuyo pake anachinyamula kupita nacho m’maholo aakulu akachisi.
A wall painting of Gajalakshmi from the: Chojambula chapakhoma cha Gajalakshmi kuchokera ku Kachisi Waukulu: mulungu wamkazi amakhala wopingasa miyendo pampando wachifumu wa lotus pomwe njovu ziwiri zowoneka bwino zimakweza miphika ndi ma lotus pamutu pake. Makatani opakidwa olemera pamwamba ndi masamba obiriwira opindika pansipa akuwonetsa kukongola kwazithunzi zanthawi ya Nayak.
A workshop of Pallava art and early Tami: Msonkhano wa zojambula za Pallava ndi zomangamanga zoyambirira za kachisi wa ku Tamil; ndi UNESCO World Heritage Site.
A yogini, one of a circle of powerful go: A yogini, mmodzi wa gulu la milungu yamphamvu yolambiridwa mu miyambo ya tantric. Gulu lochititsa chidwi la miyala yoginis yokhala pansi ikugwirizana ndi dera la Kanchipuram mu nthawi ya Chola; zitsanzo zili m'malo osungiramo zinthu zakale padziko lonse lapansi.
